name: Mr. Green's Couloir
text: [overview] A lengthy snow gully reaches a 30m WI2 step, then another snow gully ends at the foot of the cliff, where a comfortable belay can be built before the ice above, 60m of WI3/4.

name: Grauple Fest
text: [overview] Plenty of snow slogging, then firm snow to the first pitch.
[overview] P2 (60m, WI4) the curtain, a flowing section and snow to a birch belay.
[overview] P3 (80m, easy snow) gully to a narrow waterfall, cam anchor.
[overview] P6 (40m, WI3) short ice, snowfield, odd curtain.
[overview] P7 climbs a 100m snowfield to a giant chockstone.

name: Dreamline
text: [approach] The line is reached from the cliff top instead: a snow gully leads down to the shore, then an approach gully, exposed to falling ice, leads to a long ramp that rises to the main icefall.
